title: Microsoft Excel Basics
intro: Learn how to create spreadsheets, organize data, use formulas and manage information professionally.
topic1_text: Learn about worksheets, rows, columns, cells, ribbons and basic Excel tools.
topic2_text: Learn how to enter information, adjust cell formatting and make your spreadsheet easier to read.
topic3_text: Learn simple formulas like SUM, AVERAGE and basic calculations to work faster.
topic4_text: Organize your information into tables and manage data efficiently.
practice: Practice creating a personal budget sheet using Excel.
